product_metadata.title: Reusable Silicone Food Bag Storage, 4 Packs
features: SIZE & PREMIUM QUALITY Include 4 different color reusable silicone food storage bags.

REUSABLE & ECO-FRIENDLY-Could you imagine how much food and plastic bags we throw away each day? Our food storage bags are made of healthy and eco-friendly silicone, which is reusable and recyclable, meanwhile save your time and money.

AIRTIGHT SEAL & MULTIPURPOSE- The silicone bags have an improved and ultra-convenient ziplock for airtight sealing and perfect preservation - Keep your food FRESH without any leaks. You can use them to store your fruits, vegetables, meat, milk, beverages and more.
DURABLE & WIDE APPLICATION-Excellent heat and cold resistant, Healthy, eco-friendly, recyclable. Safely used in refrigerator, microwave oven, toaster, freezer, steamer and dishwasher safe.
Don’t heat the bar and don’t put the bar into microwave.
